label: ZKN_DIAMOND_001_000
text:
For some time after its birth, it grows by taking
nourishment from the seed on its back.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_002_000
text:
When the bud on its back starts swelling,
a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s
coming bloom.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_003_000
text:
After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells
stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_004_000
text:
The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of
its life. If the Pokémon is healthy, its tail
burns intensely.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_005_000
text:
In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live,
their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_006_000
text:
It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if
it has experienced harsh battles.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_007_000
text:
It hides in its shell to protect itself, then strikes
back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_008_000
text:
It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is
popular as a symbol of longevity.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_009_000
text:
The jets of water it spouts from the rocket
cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_010_000
text:
It releases a stench from its red antennae to repel
enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_011_000
text:
A steel-hard shell protects its tender body.
The Pokémon quietly endures hardships while
awaiting evolution.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_012_000
text:
It loves the nectar of flowers and can locate
flower patches that have even tiny amounts
of pollen.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_013_000
text:
It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off
attackers with the needle on its head.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_014_000
text:
While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators
under leaves and in nooks of branches.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_015_000
text:
Its best attack involves flying around at high
speed, striking with poison needles, then
flying off.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_016_000
text:
It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict.
If disturbed, however, it can ferociously
strike back.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_017_000
text:
It flies over its wide territory in search of prey,
downing it with its highly developed claws.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_018_000
text:
By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot
can make a gust of wind capable of bending
tall trees.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_019_000
text:
It’s cautious in the extreme, and its hardy vitality
lets it live in any kind of environment.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_020_000
text:
It whittles down its constantly growing fangs
by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart
cinder block walls.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_021_000
text:
It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak,
it searches in grass for prey.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_022_000
text:
It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad
wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_023_000
text:
It sneaks through grass without making a sound
and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_024_000
text:
The pattern on its belly is for intimidation.
It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_025_000
text:
It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity
in the electric sacs on its cheeks.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_026_000
text:
It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in
its body. It discharges power through its tail.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_027_000
text:
To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a
ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_028_000
text:
It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back.
Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_029_000
text:
While this Pokémon does not prefer to fight,
even one drop of the venom it secretes from its
barbs can be fatal.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_030_000
text:
When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs
on its body. These barbs grow more slowly
than Nidorino’s.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_031_000
text:
Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will
protect the young in its burrow with its life.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_032_000
text:
It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of
the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_033_000
text:
It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with
its horn, which oozes venom upon impact.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_034_000
text:
One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone
pole as if it were a matchstick.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_035_000
text:
Thought to live with others on quiet mountains,
it is popular for its adorable nature.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_036_000
text:
Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by
the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_037_000
text:
It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails
split from their tips to make more tails.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_038_000
text:
Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a
mystic power. The Pokémon is said to live
for 1,000 years.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_039_000
text:
When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins
singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_040_000
text:
Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can
expand its body by inhaling air.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_041_000
text:
Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles
using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_042_000
text:
It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon.
It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_043_000
text:
It often plants its root feet in the ground during
the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_044_000
text:
The nectar it drools from its mouth smells so
atrocious that it can make noses curl from more
than a mile away.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_045_000
text:
Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks,
it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_046_000
text:
Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back.
They grow along with the host Paras.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_047_000
text:
Parasect is controlled by a mushroom that has
grown larger than its host’s body. The Pokémon
scatters poisonous spores.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_048_000
text:
Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes.
At night, its kind is drawn by light.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_049_000
text:
It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales.
The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_050_000
text:
This Pokémon lives underground. Because of its
dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_051_000
text:
Its three heads move alternately, driving it
through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_052_000
text:
It is nocturnal by nature. If it spots something
shiny, its eyes glitter as brightly as the
shiny object.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_053_000
text:
It is a very haughty Pokémon. Among fans of
Persian, the size of the jewel in its forehead is
a topic of much talk.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_054_000
text:
If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting
odd powers. It can’t remember doing
so, however.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_055_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in lakes. It swims faster than
any world-class swimmer.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_056_000
text:
It lives in treetop colonies. If one member of
the group becomes enraged, the whole colony
rampages for no reason.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_057_000
text:
It becomes angry if it sees an opponent’s eyes
and gets angrier if the opponent runs. Even after
it beats the opponent, it is still angry.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_058_000
text:
It is a Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain
motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_059_000
text:
Its proud and regal appearance has captured the
hearts of people since long ago.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_060_000
text:
Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible.
It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_061_000
text:
The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates.
Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_062_000
text:
With its extremely tough muscles, it could keep
swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_063_000
text:
It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it
teleports itself while remaining seated.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_064_000
text:
If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on
TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring
bad luck.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_065_000
text:
Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has
experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_066_000
text:
It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen
its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_067_000
text:
Machoke’s boundless power is very dangerous,
so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_068_000
text:
It punches with its four arms at blinding speed.
It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_069_000
text:
It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick
at capturing prey with its vines.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_070_000
text:
This Pokémon has the appearance of a
plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them
with a toxic powder.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_071_000
text:
In its mouth, it pools a fragrant nectar-like fluid.
The fluid is really an acid that dissolves anything.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_072_000
text:
Its body is mostly composed of water. It shoots
strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_073_000
text:
With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it
prevents escape until the prey is weakened
by poison.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_074_000
text:
Many live on mountain trails and remain
half-buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_075_000
text:
Graveler make their homes on sheer cliff faces
that have numerous holes in them.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_076_000
text:
It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulder-like
body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_077_000
text:
About an hour after birth, Ponyta’s fiery
mane and tail grow out, giving the Pokémon
an impressive appearance.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_078_000
text:
It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane
blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_079_000
text:
Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail.
It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_080_000
text:
Though usually dim-witted, it seems to become
inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_081_000
text:
The units at its sides generate electromagnetic
waves that keep it airborne. It feeds
on electricity.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_082_000
text:
A Magneton is actually three Magnemite linked
by magnetism. A group of these Pokémon can set
off a magnetic storm.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_083_000
text:
It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why
it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_084_000
text:
The brains in its two heads appear to
communicate emotions to each other with
a telepathic power.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_085_000
text:
When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one
of its heads splits into two. This Pokémon runs at
nearly 40 mph.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_086_000
text:
This Pokémon lives on icebergs. It uses the sharp
point on its head to break up ice as it swims in
the sea.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_087_000
text:
In snow, the pure white coat covering its body
obscures it from predators.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_088_000
text:
It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was
exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears
among filth.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_089_000
text:
A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid
kills plants and trees immediately upon contact.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_090_000
text:
It swims backward by opening and closing its two
shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_091_000
text:
It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for
protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_092_000
text:
This Pokémon’s body is 95 percent made up
of gases. The Pokémon can be blown away by
strong gusts of wind.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_093_000
text:
It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside
walls to keep an eye on its foes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_094_000
text:
It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where
Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by
nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_095_000
text:
When it travels underground, it causes rumbling
and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_096_000
text:
It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing
with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_097_000
text:
Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep
in three seconds, even in someone who just
woke up.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_098_000
text:
It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches.
Its pincers fully grow back if they are lost in battle.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_099_000
text:
The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower
strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult
to aim.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_100_000
text:
It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous
because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_101_000
text:
It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to
bursting with stored electricity.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_102_000
text:
Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can
quickly gather if they become separated.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_103_000
text:
It is called the Walking Jungle. If a head grows
too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_104_000
text:
When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries.
Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_105_000
text:
The bones it uses have been in its possession
since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_106_000
text:
Its legs can stretch to double their length.
First-time foes are startled by Hitmonlee’s
extensible reach.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_107_000
text:
When Hitmonchan twists its arm while throwing a
punch, the blow will pulverize even concrete. The
Pokémon rests after three minutes of fighting.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_108_000
text:
Instead of its hands, it uses its tongue, which
can stretch to twice this Pokémon’s height.
Lickitung’s sticky saliva grips anything.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_109_000
text:
Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft.
The gases not only smell; they are also explosive.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_110_000
text:
It grows by feeding on gases released by
garbage. Though very rare, triplets have
been found.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_111_000
text:
Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles
topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_112_000
text:
Its brain developed after it stood up on its
hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through
solid rock.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_113_000
text:
It is said to deliver happiness.
Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with
injured people.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_114_000
text:
It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the
face hidden behind this growth of vines.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_115_000
text:
It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its
baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_116_000
text:
It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses
danger, it spits black ink and flees.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_117_000
text:
Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones
are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_118_000
text:
It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it
were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_119_000
text:
It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in
streams with its horn. The Pokémon defends
its eggs with its life.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_120_000
text:
If Staryu’s body is damaged, it will regenerate as
long as the red core remains. The core flashes
at midnight.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_121_000
text:
At the center of its body is a red core that sends
mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_122_000
text:
It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible
but solid walls using miming gestures.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_123_000
text:
It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking
scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_124_000
text:
Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is
impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_125_000
text:
Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon
appears at power plants and eats electricity.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_126_000
text:
It was born in the crater of a volcano. Its body is
covered with flames that shimmer like the sun.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_127_000
text:
It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn
apart. What it can’t tear, it tosses far away.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_128_000
text:
Once it takes aim at its prey, it makes a headlong
charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_129_000
text:
It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon.
No one knows why it has managed to survive.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_130_000
text:
Once Gyarados appears, its rage never settles
until the Pokémon has razed the fields and
mountains around it.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_131_000
text:
It loves crossing the sea with people and
Pokémon on its back. It understands
human speech.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_132_000
text:
It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular
structure to transform into whatever it sees.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_133_000
text:
It is a rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh
environments by changing its appearance and
capabilities when it evolves.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_134_000
text:
It has evolved to be suited for an aquatic life.
It can become invisible when it melts away
into water.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_135_000
text:
It controls 10,000-volt power. When the fur
covering its body stands on end, the fur is hard
and sharp, like needles.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_136_000
text:
It has a flame sac in its body. Its body
temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit
before battle.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_137_000
text:
The world’s first artificially created Pokémon.
It can travel through electronic space.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_138_000
text:
It’s a Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil
using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_139_000
text:
It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct
because its spiral shell grew too large.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_140_000
text:
It is thought to have inhabited beaches
300 million years ago. It is protected by a
sturdy shell.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_141_000
text:
It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land
because its prey adapted to life on land.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_142_000
text:
It’s a Pokémon that roamed the skies in the
dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_143_000
text:
Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if
it happens to be moldy or rotten.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_144_000
text:
This legendary bird Pokémon can create
blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_145_000
text:
This legendary Pokémon is said to live in
thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_146_000
text:
It is one of the legendary bird Pokémon.
Its appearance is said to indicate the
coming of spring.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_147_000
text:
It is called the Mirage Pokémon because so few
have seen it, but its shed skin has been found.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_148_000
text:
If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes
instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_149_000
text:
It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea.
It guides wrecked ships to shore.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_150_000
text:
Mewtwo was created by recombining Mew’s
genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart
among Pokémon.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_151_000
text:
Because it can use all kinds of moves, many
scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor
of Pokémon.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_152_000
text:
It uses the leaf on its head to determine the air’s
temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_153_000
text:
The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma
that perks people up.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_154_000
text:
Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead
plants and flowers.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_155_000
text:
It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames
on its back burn more vigorously.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_156_000
text:
It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames.
The fire burns stronger as it prepares to fight.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_157_000
text:
It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat
shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_158_000
text:
It has a habit of biting everything with its
well-developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs
to be careful.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_159_000
text:
Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses
its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_160_000
text:
It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding
speed when it attacks and bites prey.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_161_000
text:
It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high
on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_162_000
text:
The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling
up around them. It corners foes with speed.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_163_000
text:
It always stands on one foot. Even when
attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_164_000
text:
Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects
as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_165_000
text:
It’s so timid that it can’t move unless it’s with
a swarm. It conveys its feelings through scent.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_166_000
text:
It uses starlight as energy. When more stars
appear at night, the patterns on its back
grow larger.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_167_000
text:
It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but
strong thread. It waits motionlessly for prey
to arrive.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_168_000
text:
It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free.
Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_169_000
text:
Having four wings enables it to fly faster
and more quietly. It turns active when the
night comes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_170_000
text:
It discharges positive and negative electricity
from the tips of its antennae to shock its foes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_171_000
text:
Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths.
It is nicknamed the Deep-Sea Star.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_172_000
text:
The electric sacs on its cheeks are still small.
They cannot store much electricity yet.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_173_000
text:
Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive
riding on shooting stars.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_174_000
text:
It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts
bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_175_000
text:
Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that
it shares with kindhearted people.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_176_000
text:
It is said to appear in front of kindly people to
scatter a glowing down called joy dust.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_177_000
text:
It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding
buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_178_000
text:
This odd Pokémon can see both the past and
the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_179_000
text:
Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static
electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_180_000
text:
If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity,
its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire hair that zaps
on impact.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_181_000
text:
The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden
days, people sent signals using the light from
this Pokémon’s tail.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_182_000
text:

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_364_000
text:
It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so,
it learns textures and odors.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_365_000
text:
It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber
repels not only the cold but also enemy attacks.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_366_000
text:
It makes a single pearl during its lifetime.
The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_367_000
text:
It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a
small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_368_000
text:
It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the
springtime, its pink body turns more vivid
for some reason.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_369_000
text:
This rare Pokémon was discovered during a
deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in
over 100 million years.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_370_000
text:
It lives in warm seas. It is said that couples
who find this Pokémon will be blessed with
eternal love.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_371_000
text:
Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by
leaping off cliffs every day.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_372_000
text:
Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun
changing. The shell peels off the instant the
Pokémon evolves.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_373_000
text:
As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its
cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_374_000
text:
They converse with one another by using
magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in
perfect unison.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_375_000
text:
It is formed by two Beldum joining together.
Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides
with a jet.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_376_000
text:
Metang combined to form it. With four brains,
it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_377_000
text:
Its entire body is made of rock. If any part
chips off in battle, Regirock attaches rocks
to repair itself.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_378_000
text:
Its body is made of ice from the ice age.
It controls frigid air of −328 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_379_000
text:
Tempered by pressure underground over tens of
thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_380_000
text:
Its body is covered with a down that can refract
light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_381_000
text:
It is a highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back
its forelegs in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_382_000
text:
It is said to have widened the seas by causing
downpours. It had been asleep in a
marine trench.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_383_000
text:
It had been asleep in underground magma ever
since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_384_000
text:
It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds
and cannot be seen from the ground.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_385_000
text:
It is said to wake up for just seven days every
1,000 years and use its power to grant any wish.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_386_000
text:
An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteorite
underwent a DNA mutation to become
this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_387_000
text:
Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens
when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_388_000
text:
It lives along water in forests. In the daytime,
it leaves the forest to sunbathe the trees on
its shell.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_389_000
text:
Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its
unmoving back to begin building their nests.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_390_000
text:
It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy
mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_391_000
text:
To intimidate attackers, it expands the fire on
its tail to make itself appear bigger.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_392_000
text:
It uses a special kind of martial arts involving
all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_393_000
text:
Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food
from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_394_000
text:
It lives alone, away from others. Apparently,
every one of them believes it is the
most important.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_395_000
text:
The three horns that extend from its beak attest
to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_396_000
text:
They flock in great numbers. Though small, they
flap their wings with great power.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_397_000
text:
They fly around forests and fields in search of
bug Pokémon, moving together in huge flocks.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_398_000
text:
It has a savage nature. It will courageously
challenge foes that are much larger than itself.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_399_000
text:
With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is
more agile and active than it appears.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_400_000
text:
It makes its nest by damming streams with bark
and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_401_000
text:
It shakes its head back to front, causing its
antennae to hit each other and sound like
a xylophone.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_402_000
text:
It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest
when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_403_000
text:
All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees
while the foe is momentarily blinded.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_404_000
text:
Its claws loose electricity with enough
amperage to cause opponents to faint.
It lives in small groups.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_405_000
text:
It has eyes that can see through anything.
It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_406_000
text:
Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the
cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_407_000
text:
It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs
it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_408_000
text:
It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago.
Its skull is as hard as iron.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_409_000
text:
Its powerful headbutt has enough force
to shatter even the most durable things
upon impact.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_410_000
text:
A Pokémon that lived in jungles around
100 million years ago. Its facial hide is
extremely hard.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_411_000
text:
Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile
Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_412_000
text:
To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers
itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_413_000
text:
When Burmy evolves, its cloak becomes a part of
its body. Wormadam’s cloak is never shed.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_414_000
text:
It loves the nectar of flowers and steals nectar
collected by Combee.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_415_000
text:
Three Pokémon joined to become one. It busily
carries sweet nectar to Vespiquen.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_416_000
text:
Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises
its grubs on nectar collected by Combee.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_417_000
text:
It stores its own fur balls that crackle with static
electricity together with its favorite berries
in tree hollows.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_418_000
text:
When air fills the flotation sac on its neck, the sac
balloons like an inner tube. This Pokémon floats
with its head out of the water.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_419_000
text:
It floats using its well-developed flotation sac.
It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_420_000
text:
The small ball holds the nutrients needed for
evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_421_000
text:
It blooms during times of strong sunlight.
The Pokémon tries to make up for everything
it endured as a bud.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_422_000
text:
Its colors and shapes differ from region to region.
In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_423_000
text:
It has a pliable body without any bones. If any
part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_424_000
text:
To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails.
It rarely uses its arms now.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_425_000
text:
It is a Pokémon formed by the spirits of people
and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_426_000
text:
They’re drowsy in daytime but fly off in the
evening in big groups. No one knows where
they go.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_427_000
text:
It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears.
It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_428_000
text:
An extremely cautious Pokémon that cloaks its
body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_429_000
text:
Its cries sound like incantations.
Those who hear it are tormented by headaches
and hallucinations.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_430_000
text:
Becoming active at night, it is known to form
flocks with numerous Murkrow in tow.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_431_000
text:
It claws if displeased and purrs when
affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular
among some.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_432_000
text:
It is a brazen brute that barges its way into
another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_433_000
text:
It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of
its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_434_000
text:
It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from
its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_435_000
text:
It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its
tail to attack. It can fire this spray more than
160 feet.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_436_000
text:
Implements shaped like Bronzor were discovered
in ancient tombs. It is unknown whether they
are related.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_437_000
text:
One caused a media storm when it was dug up
at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_438_000
text:
It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually
adjusting its body’s fluid levels by
eliminating excess.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_439_000
text:
It habitually mimics foes. The mimicked foe is
said to be unable to look away from Mime Jr.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_440_000
text:
It loves round, white things. It carries an
egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_441_000
text:
They can learn and speak human words.
If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_442_000
text:
It is a Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits.
It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_443_000
text:
It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls.
It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_444_000
text:
There is a long-held belief that medicine made
from its scales will heal incurable illnesses.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_445_000
text:
When it folds up its body and extends its wings,
it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_446_000
text:
It wolfs down its weight in food once a day,
swallowing it whole with almost no chewing.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_447_000
text:
The aura that emanates from its body intensifies
to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_448_000
text:
It has the ability to sense the auras of all things.
It understands human speech.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_449_000
text:
It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration,
it expels grainy sand from its body.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_450_000
text:
It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its
body to create a towering twister for attack.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_451_000
text:
It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison.
It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_452_000
text:
It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap
of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_453_000
text:
Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes
off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_454_000
text:
Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even
a scratch could prove fatal.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_455_000
text:
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then
chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat
its prey.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_456_000
text:
After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on
its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_457_000
text:
It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by
flashing patterns on its four fins.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_458_000
text:
A friendly Pokémon that senses the subtle flows
of seawater using its two antennae.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_459_000
text:
It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little
contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_460_000
text:
It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always
buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_461_000
text:
They live in cold regions, forming groups
of four or five that hunt prey with
impressive coordination.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_462_000
text:
It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic
field. Its three units generate magnetism.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_463_000
text:
It wraps things with its extensible tongue.
Getting too close to it will leave you soaked
with drool.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_464_000
text:
It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its
muscles to shoot them. On rare occasions,
the Pokémon even shoots out Geodude.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_465_000
text:
It ensnares prey by extending arms made of
vines. Losing arms to predators does not
trouble it.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_466_000
text:
It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe,
then lets loose with over 20,000 volts
of electricity.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_467_000
text:
It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees
Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms.
It lives in volcanic craters.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_468_000
text:
It will never appear where there is strife.
Sightings of this Pokémon have recently
become rare.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_469_000
text:
By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that
inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_470_000
text:
Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis.
As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_471_000
text:
As a defense mechanism, it can completely
freeze its fur to make its hairs stand out
like needles.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_472_000
text:
It observes prey while hanging inverted from
branches. When the chance presents itself,
Gliscor swoops!

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_473_000
text:
Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The ice age
is over and the climate has warmed, so this
Pokémon’s population has thinned.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_474_000
text:
Additional software was installed to make it an
even better Pokémon. It began acting
oddly, however.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_475_000
text:
A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights
using the extending swords on its elbows.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_476_000
text:
Its entire body exudes strong magnetism.
Probopass controls three small units
called Mini-Noses.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_477_000
text:
The antenna on its head captures radio waves
from the world of spirits that command it to take
people there.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_478_000
text:
It freezes foes with an icy breath that is nearly
−60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its
body is actually hollow.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_479_000
text:
Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to
infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_480_000
text:
Known as the Being of Knowledge, it is said that
it can wipe out the memory of those who see
its eyes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_481_000
text:
It is known as the Being of Emotion. It taught
humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_482_000
text:
It is known as the Being of Willpower. It sleeps at
the bottom of a lake to keep the world
in balance.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_483_000
text:
It has the power to control time. It appears in
Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_484_000
text:
It has the ability to distort space. It is described
as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_485_000
text:
It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its
cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_486_000
text:
There is an enduring legend that states this
Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_487_000
text:
A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on
the reverse side of ours. It appears in an
ancient cemetery.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_488_000
text:
When it flies, it releases shiny particles from
its veil-like wings. It is said to represent the
crescent moon.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_489_000
text:
A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates
the flotation sac on its head to drift and search
for food.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_490_000
text:
Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great
distances to return to its birthplace.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_491_000
text:
It can lull people to sleep and make them dream.
It is active during nights of a new moon.

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_492_000
text:
It lives in common flower patches but is rarely
noticed. It is often mistaken for a flowering plant

label: ZKN_DIAMOND_493_000

It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that
